title: Interrupting Claude's Generation
body:
**Bug Description**

It doesn't seem possible to break Claude's generation and keep the context. I can abort with Control+c but Claude continues calculating. A further Control+c ends the session and the conversation context is lost.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: f8fd20cc-698d-468a-bb72-79f4fae6a252
author: dirkintelligence
